title: Step under return embedding
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $N$ be a $k$-work-tape machine with state set $S$, and let $R$ be such a machine with state set $S \sqcup \{\ast\}$. Suppose that, at every state in the left summand, $R$'s transition is the return embedding of $N$'s transition, and that at the added state its transition makes no tape changes or output, stays in that state, and does not move either the input head or any work-tape head. Then, for every configuration $c$ of $N$, taking one step of $R$ from the return embedding of $c$ gives the return embedding of the configuration obtained by taking one step of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A $k$-work-tape machine $R$ with state set $S$ disjoint-unioned with a singleton
